summary: A Google DeepMind researcher announced Gemini 3.8 Flash as an upgrade over 3.7 Flash, claiming it outperforms larger frontier models on complex engineering problems at lower cost, with a link to further details.

practices.reason: The claimed jump in complex engineering problem performance versus larger models, at lower cost, would be worth evaluating for coding-heavy workloads before adoption since no specific benchmark figures are given.
practices.quote: 3.8 Flash is a big step up from 3.7 Flash, outperforming most larger frontier models in complex engineering problems, at a fraction of the cost.
